description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Pirated Copy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Pirated Copy dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Pirated Copy that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Pirated Copy token instead.
